data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1492's gross opening claims reserves at 1 January 2022 were GBP 192.604m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle (excluding the two most recent underwriting years) indicates a small net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 3.7m (1.9% of opening reserves), i.e. a modest strengthening of reserves. Management completed a legacy transaction with Enstar in 2022 transferring 2018 & prior years which provided capital benefit and mitigated the impact of inflation on prior reserves; a 2020 Part VII transfer to Lloyd's Brussels had no economic impact. The movement is influenced by claims experience dynamics, reinsurance transactions and inflationary pressures.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) gross figure was not explicitly stated in a single 'movement in prior years' note. PYD was calculated from the published gross claims development table (claims triangle) by comparing the current estimate to the prior diagonal for underwriting years <= 2020 and excluding 2021 and 2022. The triangle and PYD may be distorted by the 2022 Enstar legacy transaction (2018 & prior) and by RITC activity; no explicit gross prior-year movement sentence was found. Lob movements reported are simple 2022 vs 2021 gross outstanding changes (these include current year activity and are therefore a low-confidence proxy, not true PYD by line).
